sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.content: Link2Builder (“we”, “our”, “platform”) values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

subsections.heading: a) Personal Information
list: Name, phone number, email address
Location details
Any information shared during registration or inquiries

subsections.heading: b) Usage Data
list: App/website activity
Device information, IP address, browser type
Interaction with listings and video calls

subsections.heading: c) Communication Data
list: Messages, call details, and interactions with builders (for service improvement and safety)

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
list: Connect you with verified builders
Schedule and manage video calls
Provide property details and recommendations
Improve platform performance and user experience
Send updates, offers, and service notifications

sections.heading: 4. Sharing of Information
sections.content: We may share your information with:
list: Builders you connect with through the platform
Service providers (payment gateways, hosting, analytics)
Legal authorities, if required by law
sections.note: We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: 5. Data Security
list: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your data
However, no digital platform can guarantee 100% security

sections.heading: 6. Cookies & Tracking
list: We may use cookies and similar technologies
These help improve user experience and analyze usage patterns

sections.heading: 7. User Rights
list: Access or update your personal data
Request deletion of your account
Opt out of marketing communications

sections.heading: 8. Data Retention
sections.content: We retain your data only as long as necessary for service and legal purposes

sections.heading: 9. Third-Party Links
sections.content: Our platform may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices.

sections.heading: 10. Children’s Privacy
sections.content: Our platform is not intended for users under 18 years

sections.heading: 11. Changes to Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Continued use of the platform means acceptance of updates.

sections.heading: 12. Contact Us
list: link2builder@gmail.com
